trust_decision.summary: Whether a shell_exec command string may run is decided by SecurityValidator.validateCommand (allowlist of executables plus metacharacter filters); with no config file the security policy defaults to disabled, and the shipped allowlist trusts interpreters (bash, python3, git) that run arbitrary inner commands.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'secure mode allowlist bypass via /bin/bash'; an engineer goes to the allowlist match loop in validateExecutableCommand and to the bash entry in security.yaml:29.

fix_sites.entry_point: process startup (loadConfig from main.go:21), then MCP tool shell_exec (main.go:84-102)
fix_sites.module_kind: defaults_or_merge_route (config loader built-in defaults: Enabled false -> secure default allowlist, fix.diff:113-147)
validator constructor; adds warning-only interpreter detection (fix.diff:315-351)

fix_sites.entry_point: MCP tool shell_exec -> security.go:72 and executor.go:126 (shared helper)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: config.go:47-50 (built-in defaults used when MCP_SHELL_SEC_CONFIG_FILE is unset); shipped policy in security.yaml:27-29 (config, not source)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The 'no config file means unrestricted' default is documented intended behaviour (README.md:32, README.md:137), so a solver can argue the defaults route is a product decision, not part of the allowlist bypass.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Allowlisted non-interpreter executables (ls, echo, grep, find ...) with ordinary arguments must keep running in secure mode, and an explicit unsafe opt-in must still disable validation; an over-broad fix (rejecting any allowlist or all '!' / '=' characters in args, or refusing to start when a config lists git) breaks legitimate use.

O6_input_shapes: no config file at all (defaults route)
config file allowlisting an interpreter by absolute path (/bin/bash, /usr/bin/python3, /usr/bin/git)
allowlisted git with a '-c alias.x=!cmd' argument (the '!' and '=!' filter additions)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A config file that omits the 'enabled' key overwrites the (post-fix secure) default with false, so security is silently disabled; the fix left this assignment unchanged.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Operator wrote a config file; YAML zero value is 'their choice', and the fix's README says the file 'overrides built-in secure defaults' (fix.diff:57).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the defaults fix site, separate function (loadSecurityFromFile)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Basename allowlist match accepts a relative path containing a separator (e.g. a sub/dir path whose base name equals an allowed name), so the allowlisted identity can resolve to a different binary than the one intended.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Requires an attacker-placed file in the working directory; looks like a separate path-resolution issue, not the interpreter bypass.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as landing point, different function (matchesExecutable)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Allowlisting an interpreter still passes validation after the fix: warnOnInterpreters only logs, so an interpreter in allowed_executables runs any inner command.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Maintainer chose warn-not-block (fix.diff:325-340); blocking would break operators who intentionally allowlist git.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: executor.parseCommand re-checks only the executable for metacharacters and only args for constructs; a planted divergence between validator and executor tokenisation would be a parser differential on the executable identity.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Two independent parse passes already exist (security.go:77 and executor.go:110); a maintainer could plausibly 'improve' one (quote-aware split) without the other.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An env-var override (e.g. MCP_SHELL_ALLOWED_EXECUTABLES) merged after the file load that appends to the allowlist without interpreter screening.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: getEnv/getBoolEnv helpers already drive other settings (config.go:52-58, config.go:139-153).

O9_family: insecure default / incomplete allowlist leading to OS command execution (CWE-1188, CWE-183, CWE-78)

O10_build.project_tests: config_test.go (loadConfig defaults, YAML loading), security_test.go (validateCommand, validateExecutableCommand, validateLegacyCommand tables), executor_test.go, handler_test.go

j.j_sites_touched: config.go, security.go (plus main.go log message only; security.yaml and README config/docs)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Delete /bin/bash from security.yaml (or reject 'bash -c') in validateExecutableCommand, leaving the insecure no-config default in config.go and the git '!' alias route open.

out_of_scope_notes: find stays in the fix's own default allowlist and can spawn processes via -exec; the fix only documents it (fix.diff:388-389).
